CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

3. Best practice when working on Athletics and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics and Mosaic.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics and Mosaic.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics and Mosaic.

4. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
